title: Span
description: A single LLM call or logical unit of work within a Trace.

trace_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the trace this span belongs to.

span_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this span.

parent_span_id.description: span_id of the parent span, if this is a child span.

name.description: Human-readable name for this span (e.g. the operation name).

start_time_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the span started.

end_time_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the span ended.

duration_ms.description: Duration of the span in milliseconds (end_time_ms - start_time_ms).

model.description: The model name as reported by the OTel attribute gen_ai.request.model.

finish_reason.description: Why the model stopped generating (e.g. stop, length, tool_calls).

cost_usd.description: Computed cost in USD for this span, derived from token counts and the pricing table.

user_id.description: End-client / user identifier — the metering and cost-attribution dimension the dashboard breaks spend down by. A business label, not an access boundary.

workspace_id.description: Workspace the span belongs to. This is the access-control unit: an account may read a workspace's spans only if it is a member of that workspace (see the /v1/workspaces endpoints). Set by the collector from the verified ingest API key's workspace; any tracium.workspace.id the sender supplies is overwritten.

model_normalized.description: The model value lower-cased, trimmed and sanitised. No alias resolution is applied ('gpt-4o-2024-08-06' stays 'gpt-4o-2024-08-06').

schema_version.description: Schema version of this span record. The collector currently writes 1; additive fields do not bump it.

error_message.description: Human-readable error message if the span failed.

workflow_name.description: Workflow that owns this span. Derived by the collector from the first non-empty of gen_ai.agent.name, traceloop.workflow.name, traceloop.entity.name, the resource service.name, or the span name.

service_name.description: Resource-level service.name, stored verbatim. The OTel 'unknown_service' default is stored as empty.

workflow_version.description: Version the span ran under: the resource's tracium.workflow.version. Capped at 128 bytes; empty when none is set.

source.description: How the row entered Tracium: 'span' for a per-call span, 'metric' for an aggregate built from an OTLP gen_ai.client.token.usage metric.

attributes.description: Custom span and resource attributes not promoted to a typed field. The gen_ai.*, tracium.*, llm.*, traceloop.* namespaces and service.name are excluded.

kind.description: Normalized span role, derived by the collector from instrumentation attributes (OpenInference openinference.span.kind, Traceloop traceloop.span.kind, or the OTel GenAI gen_ai.operation.name). Optional: omitted when the collector could not classify the span, in which case consumers infer the role from the span's context (e.g. parent chain).

input.description: Captured prompt/input content for this span. Only present when content capture is enabled in the collector (see capture_content); otherwise absent.

output.description: Captured completion/output content for this span. Only present when content capture is enabled in the collector; otherwise absent.

available_tools.description: Tools made available to the model on this span and whether each was invoked. Computed by the collector from gen_ai.tool.definitions, falling back to OpenLLMetry's llm.request.functions.*, and stored as the tracium.available_tools attribute. Tool metadata is not raw content and is captured regardless of capture_content.

name.description: Tool name as registered with the model.

used.description: Whether the model invoked this tool during the span.

output_tokens_derived.description: Metering provenance. True when part of output_tokens was reconciled by the collector from total_tokens rather than reported by the provider — Google bills Gemini thoughts_token_count at the output rate, but OpenLLMetry maps only candidates_token_count onto gen_ai.usage.output_tokens. Consumers should treat a derived count as an estimate. Absent/false means the provider reported the count whole.

unmetered.description: Metering provenance. True when the span returned a completion but carried no gen_ai.usage.* attributes at all, so its cost_usd of 0 is unknown rather than genuinely free. Chiefly a streamed OpenAI call made without stream_options={"include_usage": true}. Consumers must not read cost_usd = 0 on such a span as $0 of real spend.
